draft.headline: Jake White's Fiji debut starts with a Tokyo rematch
beats: Five weeks ago at Prince Chichibu Memorial Stadium, Japan beat Fiji 20–15 to win the Pacific Nations Cup final. Fiji return to Tokyo with 2007 World Cup winner Jake White taking charge for his first test.
The rankings sharpen the fixture. A Fiji win moves them up to ninth above Japan, dropping the hosts to 12th at best. Any Japan victory leaves Fiji 12th at best.

Japan bring three straight home wins into the game, while Fiji have won once in five tests in 2026. White wants structure without losing flair: "The theory for me is we want Fiji to play like Fiji but just give them a little bit more structure, a little bit more formation."
On 7 November both head to Europe for the Nations Championship, Japan away to Wales and Fiji away to France.

beats: An Argentina win at Aviva Stadium would drop Ireland to fourth in the world rankings, behind France. A victory by 16 points or more would also lift Argentina above Australia into seventh.

Argentina have won one of six matches in 2026, most recently drawing 28–28 with Australia in September.
On 14 November, Ireland host Fiji in Dublin while Argentina visit Italy.

draft.headline: Top-ranked South Africa take on winless Italy in Turin
beats: Top-ranked South Africa face an Italian side sitting 11th in the Nations Championship table and searching for their first tournament point. The match takes international rugby to Allianz Stadium in Turin.

The rankings give the Springboks no room for error. Anything less than a win drops South Africa below New Zealand to second, while an Italian victory would elevate the hosts to ninth, above Japan, Fiji and Wales.

Form heavily favours the visitors. Italy have lost four straight Tests, including a 57–10 defeat to Australia in July. South Africa lost 42–38 to Australia in September, but have won eight of their ten matches in 2026. The Boks won 32–14 in Italy when the sides last met in November 2025.
After Turin, Italy remain at home to face Argentina, while South Africa travel to France.

draft.headline: Italy host South Africa, who lost their last game
beats: Italy have lost four in a row. Their three Nations Championship games went 10–27 to Japan, 17–47 to New Zealand and 10–57 to Australia.
South Africa's last game was a 38–42 defeat away to Australia on 27 September.
Their last meeting, at home on 15 November 2025, ended 14–32 to South Africa.
The table cuts both ways. A South Africa win keeps them first. An Italy win, or a draw, lifts Italy to 9th and drops South Africa to 2nd, below New Zealand.
Victor Matfield expects Rassie Erasmus to test his depth in November. "There are still some combinations that we can get better," he said.

draft.headline: First meets last in Turin, and only first can lose rank
beats: South Africa top the Nations Championship on points difference, level on 15 with New Zealand. Italy sit eleventh with nothing: three games, three defeats, 94 points worse off than they scored. Juventus' ground in Turin hosts the pair.
Anything short of a Springbok win puts New Zealand first in the world. An Italian win lifts Italy to ninth, above Japan, Fiji and Wales. An Italian defeat moves nobody.

Italy lost 14–32 to South Africa at home last November. Since beating England in March they have lost four straight, the July scores 10–27 to Japan, 17–47 to New Zealand and 10–57 to Australia. South Africa took three of four from New Zealand, then changed the side wholesale for Perth and lost 38–42.
Victor Matfield expects Rassie Erasmus to try more young players in November, noting "There are still some combinations that we can get better", while hoping he does not field too many at once.

draft.headline: Australia can leapfrog England in the rankings
beats: A win for Australia lifts them to fifth, above England, and sends England down to seventh. A draw or an England win leaves both where they stand.
England won their last meeting 25–7 at home, on 1 November 2025. Their last two results are wins, 31–24 over Argentina and 73–8 over Fiji, both in July.
Australia have lost their last two, 19–50 away and 21–43 at home, both to New Zealand, in October.
England host Japan on 14 November. Australia play Scotland away on 15 November.

draft.headline: A win for Australia sends England down to seventh
beats: England are 5th in the world rankings and Australia 7th. If Australia win at Allianz Stadium, by any margin, they go up to 5th, above England and Scotland. England would drop to 7th, below both. If England win, neither side moves.

Australia arrive having lost twice to New Zealand in October, 19–50 away and 21–43 at home. Before that they beat South Africa 42–38 on 27 September. England have won two in a row, 73–8 at Fiji and 31–24 at Argentina, both in July. They have won 3 of 8 this year.
England won the last meeting 25–7 at home on 1 November 2025.

In the Nations Championship England are 4th on 10 points, two behind France. Australia are 7th on 8, two behind Ireland. England host Japan on 14 November. Australia then travel to Scotland on 15 November.

draft.headline: England have held fifth since July. Australia want it
beats: England have been fifth in the world rankings every week since 13 July. Australia, seventh, take that place with a win of any size at Allianz Stadium. England would drop to seventh, behind Scotland as well.
Victor Matfield has just set out what the Wallabies need to be a top-five side again. On the rankings, one result in London would do it.

Australia arrive having lost 19–50 and 21–43 to New Zealand, a fortnight after beating South Africa 42–38. England have won two straight, 73–8 against Fiji and 31–24 against Argentina, both away, but only three of eight this year.
Their last meeting, on 1 November 2025, went 25–7 to England at home.
Next, England host Japan. Australia go to Scotland, the side a win here would already have put them above.

draft.headline: One win in London puts Australia back in the top five
beats: Australia arrive seventh in the world, off 19–50 and 21–43 against New Zealand. Win at Allianz Stadium and they go above England and Scotland into fifth; England would drop to seventh. Victor Matfield has been explaining what the Wallabies need to be a 'top five' team again. One result would do it.

The last meeting was here, on 1 November 2025: England 25–7. England have two wins in a row, 73–8 in Fiji and 31–24 in Argentina, after three straight defeats before that, including 18–23 to Italy in March.
England sit fourth, two points behind France and level with Scotland and Ireland on ten; fourth plays third on finals weekend. Australia are seventh, two behind Ireland.

Northampton expect Henry Pollock and Tommy Freeman back this weekend after a rest. Bath's Sam Underhill is out until December after bicep surgery. Dan Cole worries the current style of Prem rugby could leave Steve Borthwick's side exposed in November.
England host Japan on 14 November; Australia go to Scotland the day after.

issues.claim: "The last meeting was here, on 1 November 2025: England 25–7."
issues.problem: The pack's meetings list is explicitly incomplete, so it cannot support calling 2025-11-01 the last meeting. It also gives no venue for that match. Only the score, date, and that England were at home are supported, so 'here' (Allianz Stadium) is unsupported.
issues.fix: The previous meeting in the app was on 1 November 2025, with England winning 25–7 at home.
